prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which Should You Learn First?
plan.description: A quick, blunt answer to the React vs Vue question for beginners. Learn how to choose between the two popular JavaScript frameworks based on your goal.

beats.narration: Stop agonizing over React versus Vue. Both teach you the same core skills, so the wrong choice costs you far less than you fear.
React is everywhere in job listings and has a huge ecosystem. If your goal is getting hired, React is the safer bet.
Vue is gentler for beginners. Its structure is clear, its docs are friendly, and you see results fast. If you want smooth learning, start with Vue.
Pick one, build a real project, and stick with it. Once you know one framework, learning the other takes weeks, not months.

props.text: Learn one. Build something. The other comes easy.
